statement:
∀ {ι : Type ?u.2} (s : Finset ι) (C : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ),
  0 < ρ →
    ∀ (w c : ι → ℂ) (k : ι → ℕ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, w i ∈ ball C ρ) →
        ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g (closedBall C ρ) →
            ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(C, ρ), ∑ i ∈ s, c i / (z - w i) ^ (k i + 1) + g z =
              2 * ↑π * I * ∑ i ∈ s, if k i = 0 then c i else 0
